query:
SELECT 
  pbq.id,
  pbq.quoted_amount,
  pbq.currency,
  pbq.created_at,
  pbq.updated_at,
  COUNT(qli.id) as line_item_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN qli.line_total > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as priced_items,
  SUM(CASE WHEN qli.line_total = 0 OR qli.line_total IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as zero_priced_items,
  SUM(qli.line_total) as total_from_line_items,
  MAX(qli.created_at) as latest_line_item_created
FROM panel_beater_quotes pbq
LEFT JOIN quote_line_items qli ON qli.quote_id = pbq.id
WHERE pbq.claim_id = 6240003
GROUP BY pbq.id, pbq.quoted_amount, pbq.currency, pbq.created_at, pbq.updated_at
ORDER BY pbq.updated_at DESC;
